Workarounds exploit loopholes in platform policies, making them fragile and high-risk. Localized platforms like Paystack are available in Nigeria but still depend on global financial networks, leaving them vulnerable to international sanctions or policy shifts. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses these dependencies entirely.
